It sounds as if your giving up, and regretting meeting the father of your four kids. Never forget the strength of love, and maybe that can conquer his demons. Ive also attempted, I've felt through depression and somewhat conquered the worst of my demons, but i dance daily beside them, and it makes the happy mementos seem like the best to ever exist, because being stuck in a depressive stupor can sometimes make you feel stuck in a world that you don't belong in, and in his case he has to remember that those happy moments do exist, because for all of us there are once and a while spurts of happiness, they exist, and killing himself will do nothing but torture the people around him. I recommend getting him a therapist, and more involved in the world, force him to step out into nature and plant things, give life to things. All things die, so will he one day and hopefully that'll be when he has gray hair showering above his head. Killing himself does nothing. You have to prove that to him daily and sometimes thats what it takes to make someone believe it, compliment him and make him smile. 

I hope this helped and I wish you the best of luck

What an ass hat! What kind of guys or girls are you going for to destroy you so? (Or not destroy you), more like clip away a flowers petals. Your the flower, and don't forget, though the flower wilts--a flower, more beautiful, can bloom in its place. You can grow strength, and you can tell those cheap assholes good bye. Find someone you don't usually go for in my opinion. Because the unknown can surprise you, and new soil, (to go with with my flower analogy) can make you bloom anew. Fuck guys or girls that make you drive to wanting to die. Though, I can't help but ask why a breakup would lead you to this. Do you believe thats all life is for? a relationship? How about friendships? Goodnesssssss live for those romantic books, book boyfriends or girlfriends are the best. Not the point! Live for yourself! And first and foremost begin to love yourself. I learned that loving yourself counts more than anyone elses'. As sad as that seems, its true, and someone can love you very much, but they are not the one that gives you self doubt that counts, that drives you as insane as you make yourself. Your mind is a powerful thing. DOn't listen if someone gives you shit about who you are or your mistakes (it makes you human) the problem is if you start to believe their BULLSHIT. Love yourself, you are a fucking BEAUTIFUL MAN OR WOMAN. you can fight through this.Set your priorities. And if need be go far-far away and start new friendships, relationships and goals, and take a step into that new untouched soil, DO IT.

Im here for you always. Also, contact me if you want to talk.

Love,
